prompt: I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.

timestamps.source: The outer benchmark recorder printed startedAt immediately before launching Codex. finishedAt is the observed modification time of the copied session JSONL containing its final turn.completed event; duration is their exact difference. Codex emitted no time-to-first-token field.

usage.source: Final turn.completed usage event in validation/openai-gpt-5-6-terra-xhigh-codex-20260813.session.jsonl. totalTokens is inputTokens + outputTokens; cached input and reasoning output are subsets.

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex exec --json --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-terra-xhigh-ToRduc --sandbox danger-full-access --model gpt-5.6-terra -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --output-last-message /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-record-gpt-5-6-terra-xhigh-07hCHz/final-response.md [exact benchmark prompt passed as argv]

dataSource.notes: The final shipped dashboard initializes createDemoData() using seededRandom(20260813) and calls that source 'Built-in illustrative series'. It offers CSV import and a Yahoo Finance refresh path, but the final browser validation reported that the public data endpoint was unavailable. The run probed Yahoo Finance, Stooq, Nasdaq, and Financial Modeling Prep; no successful external market dataset was embedded in the artifact.

commands.name: market-data-probes
commands.command: curl probes to Yahoo Finance, Stooq, Nasdaq, and Financial Modeling Prep
commands.result: Yahoo responded HTTP 429, Stooq returned an anti-bot page, Nasdaq returned SPY JSON for a corrected request, and the FMP demo key was invalid. These probes did not supply data to the final default dashboard.

commands.name: core-tests-and-syntax
commands.command: node tests/forecast-core.test.mjs && node --check app.js && node --check forecast-core.mjs
commands.result: forecast-core tests passed and both JavaScript modules passed syntax checks during the final validation command.

commands.name: final-headless-render
commands.result: Rendered populated values including median $4,080, 80% range $3,548–$4,701, 33% probability of gain, 92% rolling coverage, and a final screenshot; no ReferenceError, TypeError, SyntaxError, or Uncaught error matched the Chrome log.

commands.name: browser-interaction-smoke-test
commands.command: Serve on port 4180; use Chrome DevTools Protocol to set horizon to 65 and simulated paths to 1,000, then assert displayed labels, three scenario cards, and a nonzero chart width.
commands.result: browser interaction smoke test passed; forecast-core tests passed afterward.

commands.name: screenshot-presence
commands.result: Final desktop screenshot existed and was 222150 bytes before import.

warnings: An early combined test command returned exit 129 after its calculation and syntax checks passed because git diff --check was run in the intentionally non-git benchmark workspace.
An early Chrome DOM dump showed placeholders until the model corrected its own app initialization; the final rendered DOM was populated and clean.
The first Chrome DevTools Protocol interaction assertion expected 63 trading days although the range input rounds to its step value of 65; the rerun at 65 passed.
The ImageMagick identify command was unavailable during an early screenshot check, but the screenshot was successfully created and its non-empty file check passed.

commands.name: npm-install
commands.result: Added 3 packages and audited 4 packages; npm reported 0 vulnerabilities.

commands.name: full-test-suite
commands.result: All 5 unit tests and 5 browser tests passed; 1 mobile-project test was intentionally skipped. The browser test updates its xhigh-row count and aggregate-cost expectation from the manifest so the new run is included.

commands.name: new-row-opens-standalone-dashboard
commands.command: Serve the repository at http://127.0.0.1:4321/, locate .run-row[data-artifact="runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-6-terra-xhigh-codex-20260813/index.html"], and click its unique model link in the in-app browser.
commands.result: The row and its model link each had count 1. Clicking navigated to the displayed index.html and rendered the S&P 500 forecast heading, populated forecast cards, three scenario cards, 92% rolling coverage, and the Built-in illustrative series disclosure.

importVerification.result: Repository validation and the complete test suite pass, and the new table row opens the standalone multi-file dashboard directly from the showcase.
